title: A fourth pin is refused with 'You can pin up to 3 technicians.'
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. five technicians, e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Jenny Wilson", "Theresa Webb", "Kristin Watson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (one led by each):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Pin Ralph Edwards, Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb.
  4. Hover the pin control on Esther Howard's header and read any text shown.
  5. Try to click it.
  6. Unpin Jenny Wilson.
  7. Pin Esther Howard.
  8. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  9. Look at the pinned groups and Kristin Watson's pin control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With three pinned, every other pin control is disabled and explains: "You can pin up to 3 technicians."
  • Clicking the disabled control pins nobody.
  • After unpinning Jenny Wilson, Esther Howard can be pinned.
  • Tech View shows the same three pins (Ralph Edwards, Theresa Webb, Esther Howard) and Kristin Watson's pin control is disabled there too.
  • The design allows 5 pins and says "Up to 5 pinned columns, unpin one first": a limit other than 3 or other wording is a fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R8, S3-R19, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD section 9 User Feedback Summary. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), Board pin limit; on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R8: “At three pinned technicians, disable other pin controls with: “You can pin up to 3 technicians.””
  • S3-R19: “Unpinning frees a slot in both Tech View and Board View.”
